name: Nový Přerov (Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper fly to the lower hoist into a dark red hoist part bearing a white flower with yellow centre and green leaves and a white fly part.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 8 October 2001 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
